title: CCM Client Pack
description: Official client modpack for the CraftCraftMine Minecraft server
body:
📦 About this modpack

Official client modpack for the CraftCraftMine server!

Contains:
- Performance mods (Sodium)
- QoL mods (Iris, Xaero's)
- Server-optimized

📜 Usage

This pack is for players of the CraftCraftMine server.
Redistribution only with permission!
